subject: [PATCH v2 5/5] memcg: simplify high limit handling after a charge

2026-10-30.patch_summary: This patch simplifies the handling of high memory limits in the Linux kernel's memory cgroup (memcg) subsystem. It separates the hierarchy scan from high-limit enforcement, allowing for more efficient and accurate tracking of overages. The patch also clarifies comments to improve understanding of the code and ensures that pending overage checks remain independent of the scan result. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
